RFSweepMeasurementMode.description: Settings are adjusted to the provided values during the mode of measurement.

enable.description: Enables the instrument for a particular mode of the experiment.

InstrumentRole.description: Describes an instrument and its role in the context of a measurement.

output_column.description: Name of the output column to save to the data record.

current_output_column.description: Only for roles that utilize SMUs. Name of the output column to save current to the data record.

voltage_output_column.description: Only for roles that utilize SMUs. Name of the output column to save voltages to the data record.

model.description: Manufacturer model code of instrument. See possible instruments.

serial.description: Property tag or serial used to ID instruments.

*IDN?.description: Expected response to a *IDN? query or equivalent.

role.description: Designates the behavior of the instrument during the measurement.

initial_settings.description: Describes the initial state of the instrument.

monitor_mode_settings.description: Describes how the instrument should behave during the monitor mode of an RF sweep experiment.

fast_off_mode_settings.description: Describes how the instrument should behave during the monitor mode of an RF sweep experiment.
